subject: *: remove `stmtctx.IgnoreNoPartition` and use `errctx` to handle partition mismatch error (#50173)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (81f289d4012e0f1774299d16dbe0505743886f4f) in executor/sessionctx scope. The change removes `StatementContext.IgnoreNoPartition`, adds `errctx.ErrGroupNoMatchedPartition` (mapping `ErrNoPartitionForGivenValue`/`ErrRowDoesNotMatchGivenPartitionSet`), and routes the two executor call sites that previously downgraded these errors (`pkg/executor/batch_checker.go`, `pkg/executor/write.go`) through `StmtCtx.ErrCtx().HandleError(...)`. `ResetContextOfStmt`/`ResetUpdateStmtCtx` now set the new group to `LevelWarn` for `INSERT IGNORE`, `UPDATE IGNORE`, and always for `LOAD DATA`, matching the prior flag behavior. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL error/warning semantics, transaction/session behavior, or concurrency for the touched code paths.
